column1: # Default layout for boards with 32 MB flash (reTerminal E-series).
# Two app slots (app0 / app1) for OTA + an `nvs` partition for device id /
# token / WiFi creds. A separate `prov` partition (subtype `undefined` so it
# doesn't collide with the `nvs` subtype's uniqueness check) holds the
# optional first-boot provisioning blob: WiFi creds + backend URL + optional
# claim code. On first successful boot the firmware migrates the contents
# into `nvs` and erases `prov`. `storage` is the device-side cache.
